hook: SQL mein if-else? CASE WHEN bolta hai [['main hoon na']]

slides.title: CASE = SQL ka [[if-else]]
slides.note: Mummy ka logic: marks 90+ → treat, 60+ → theek, warna **chappal** 🩴

slides.title: Salary ka [[band]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary,
  CASE
    WHEN salary > 70000 THEN 'High'
    WHEN salary >= 50000 THEN 'Mid'
    ELSE 'Low'
  END AS band
FROM employees;

slides.title: Naya column [[ban gaya]]
slides.note: Kabir 70,000 pe **Mid** kyun? Condition **> 70000** thi, >= nahi 😉

slides.title: Order [[matter]] karta
points: Baaki WHEN **skip**, CASE wahi ruk gaya
slides.note: Badi condition **upar** rakho. >= 50000 pehle likha to sab Mid ho jayenge

slides.title: GROUP BY ke [[saath]]
slides.code:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN salary > 70000
    THEN 'High' ELSE 'Other'
  END AS band,
  COUNT(*) AS people
FROM employees
GROUP BY 1;
slides.note: GROUP BY 1 = pehla column. Postgres/MySQL ✅, **SQL Server ❌** (expr repeat karo)

slides.wrong:
CASE WHEN salary > 70000
  THEN 'High'
  ELSE 'Low' AS band
slides.right:
CASE WHEN salary > 70000
  THEN 'High'
  ELSE 'Low' END AS band
slides.why: **END** bhoole = syntax error. CASE khola hai to **band bhi karo**
